zh.title: 華航波音787-9新機可望年底交付2架 明年交12架
zh.summary: 華航總經理陳漢銘表示，目標今年底交付2架波音787-9，明年交付12架。
body: 中華航空總經理陳漢銘在阿姆斯特丹接受媒體聯訪時表示，華航採購的全新波音787-9客機，目標今年底可交付2架，明年再交12架。他同時指出，華航營運表現優於去年，年終可望等於或大於去年。
為達到2050淨零碳排目標，華航今天宣布，今年第5度響應天合聯盟（SkyTeam）的「航空飛行挑戰」（The Aviation Challenge, TAC）。在9月13日桃園飛往阿姆斯特丹的長程線航班中，首度添加40%的永續航班燃油（Sustainable Aviation Fuels, SAF）。
陳潔銘表示，仍希望在年底引進全新的波音787-9機隊，不僅是機隊的汰舊換新，更強調油耗可降低20%，噪音也可降低30%。他也提到，由於座椅測試碰撞導致交機時程延宕，但目前進度還算正面，並維持今年底交付2架、明年交機12架的預期。
華航積極推進機隊升級，未來787機隊規模將達24架，包含18架787-9與6架787-10，並自今年起陸續交付，規劃將先飛航首爾、大阪等亞洲航線。
陳潔銘也說明，雖然今年油價波動大，但並未衝擊華航營收。過去3個月重新檢視運能，根據載客數更換機型，貨運較好的航線也會採用大機型來增加腹艙載貨收益，加上中東戰火使華航在台轉機至北美的客群增加。
他進一步指出，若不考慮油價，今年華航營收遠優於去年，再創新高，客運7、8月表現亮眼，貨運營收每月可達新台幣70億元至新台幣80億元，但第4季尚未結束，他仍審慎樂觀。對於年終獎金，他認為今年可以等於或大於去年。

en.title: China Airlines looks to deliver 787-9 jets, receives 2 this year, 12 in 2027
en.summary: China Airlines expects to take delivery of 2 Boeing 787-9s by year-end and 12 more next year; reports strong revenue.
body: China Airlines President Chen Han-Ming said in Amsterdam that the carrier aims to take delivery of two new Boeing 787-9 aircraft by the end of this year and another 12 next year. He also indicated that the airline's operations are performing better than last year and that year-end bonuses could be at least as high as last year's.

As part of its 2050 net-zero carbon emission target, China Airlines announced Thursday it has joined SkyTeam's The Aviation Challenge (TAC) for the fifth time this year, using 40% Sustainable Aviation Fuels (SAF) on a flight from Taoyuan to Amsterdam on September 12.

Chen stated that on the new Boeing 787-9 fleet, besides replacing older aircraft, fuel consumption could be reduced by 20% and noise by 30%. He noted that delivery was delayed due to seat crash tests, but progress is positive and the plan remains to deliver two aircraft by the end of this year and 12 next year.

The carrier is advancing with its fleet upgrade, aiming for a future 787 fleet of 24 aircraft, with 18 787-9s and 6 787-10s, with deliveries beginning this year to be deployed on Asian routes such as Seoul and Osaka.

Despite fuel price volatility this year, Chen said revenue has not been impacted. Over the past three months a review of capacities has been conducted, swapping aircraft types based on loads and using larger freighters on stronger routes to raise cargo revenue. He also said the Middle East conflict boosted Taiwan's transit traffic to North American routes.

Excluding fuel, revenue this year is far better than last year, according to Chen, who noted strong 7-to-8-month passenger performance and cargo revenue of each month between 30 billion to NT$800 billion, among other figures, with caution for the final quarter of this year.
